name: Cape South Coast

climate: Shiraz sits in its sweet spot, so the wines can show the style it is known for.

terms: Wine of Origin, region, district, ward, estate

South Africa's appellation system since 1973, nested from regions down to districts and wards. A ward is roughly a European appellation. An estate wine may come from neighboring farms farmed and made together.
A red blend with 30 to 70% Pinotage, set by the industry rather than by law. Since the 2019 vintage Pinotage should be its largest part.

notes: Western Cape wines range from sturdy Rhône-style reds to aromatic Sauvignon Blanc from vineyards cooled by Atlantic breezes.

blurb.text: A region of the Western Cape, whose districts are Cape Agulhas, Elgin, Lower Duivenhoks River, Overberg, Plettenberg Bay, Swellendam and Walker Bay. Sauvignon Blanc is the most planted grape at 29%, followed by Chardonnay and Pinot Noir at 14% each.
